title: Slint Workbench settings
description: Settings of the Workbench example. The Preferences pane is built from this file: each group and setting provides its title, description, type, range or choices, and default. The editor understands this subset of JSON Schema (object properties, boolean/string/number/integer, enum, minimum, maximum); the rest is left to editors.

release.title: Release
release.description: What the application says about itself.

channel.title: Release channel
channel.description: Shown on the Application page and in the About box.

ui.title: Interface
ui.description: What the window shows. The toolbar changes at the next start.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Dark or light. Applied at once.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.description: Show the toolbar above the panes. Applies at the next start.

startup.title: Startup
startup.description: Where the application starts. Applies at the next start, except the switches.

pane.title: First pane
pane.description: The pane shown when the window opens.

pump.title: Pump on at startup
pump.description: Start with the pump running. Applied at once.

valve.title: Valve open at startup
valve.description: Start with the valve open. Applied at once.

armed.title: Interlocks armed at startup
armed.description: Start with the alarm interlock armed. Applied at once.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: The plant and the trend. Applied at once.

alarm_limit.title: Alarm threshold
alarm_limit.description: Pressure in bar at which the interlock trips.

chart_seconds.title: Trend window
chart_seconds.description: How many seconds of history the chart shows.
